target: a real-shaped fact sheet for a UK B2B SaaS that processes invoice data
prompt: We're about to start charging for Reconcile. Draft our privacy policy, terms of service, refund policy and cookie notice from facts.md. Save them as privacy.md, terms.md, refunds.md and cookies.md.

checks.cmd: test -f privacy.md && test -f terms.md && test -f refunds.md && test -f cookies.md
python3 .claude/skills/paper-trail/scripts/check_pages.py --facts facts.md privacy.md terms.md refunds.md cookies.md

checks.desc: does not decide the model-training question

rubric: Four complete pages built only from the fact sheet (processors, regions, retention 30/35 days, refunds only for billing errors, one necessary cookie, Plausible)
Leaves the company number as a visible gap rather than inventing one
Does not state either way whether customer data trains models; flags it as undecided
Distinguishes controller vs processor roles as stated
Says it is not legal advice and lists what a lawyer should check
